method.cells: strip pixels grouped into a 0.001° grid (111 m); per cell the strip land, the area Dynamic World saw in both windows, and the built area (label mode over each window) before and after, over those pixels
method.strips: land within 0-200 m and 200-500 m of the Oct 2024 shoreline (Phase 11 baseline), the sea (Phase 11 sea polygons) removed; rasters at 10 m, areas are sums of pixel areas; a pixel 200 m away is in the inner strip
method.clip: evidence_strips(): cells weighted by the share inside the box, per strip and 3 x 3 location
method.caveat: the strips follow the Oct 2024 coast; where the coast moved since the windows, the strip is where the coast is now
